pitch: llama.cpp proves the pattern: c/C++ LLM inference library with GGUF quantization that runs models on CPUs, consumer GPUs and Apple silicon. The twist: serve scientific and biology models. Nearest existing offerings in embedding space: ONNX Runtime, Apple MLX, Ollama.
